title: Limited Liability Company review
caseBoundary: Owns general US LLC structure, ownership and record implications; does not own state formation instructions, a filing service, tax-election advice or startup-cost accounting.

title: Startup Costs Accounting review
caseBoundary: Owns accounting classification and recognition of launch transactions, with a clear books-versus-US-tax boundary; does not own estimating launch funding or forming an LLC.

title: Cloud Accounting review
caseBoundary: Owns choosing and operating a cloud-accounting workflow and its record controls; not a ranked software roundup, vendor-price list or a replacement for bookkeeping rules.

title: Capital Expenditure review
caseBoundary: Owns capital expenditure and CAPEX versus OPEX classification and reconciliation; does not own selecting projects, startup funding totals or a tax-depreciation election.

title: Net Income review
caseBoundary: Owns business net income and gross-versus-net business profit; not net revenue deductions, employee take-home pay, gross-margin conversion or an EBITDA calculator.

title: Financial Reporting review
caseBoundary: Owns the preparation, reconciliation, review and release of a financial-reporting package; not ratio interpretation, financial-statement analysis or the separate income-statement template.

title: Cash Flow Analysis review
caseBoundary: Owns interpreting historical cash-flow quality, funding dependence and liquidity evidence; not preparing a cash-flow statement, forecasting payment dates or a standalone cash-flow-ratio directory.
